text:
The meal was a bowl of rice topped with a chicken and pepper stir-fry, plus an ice cream cone wrapped in foil and a glass of water.

Estimated before eating:
- Rice: about 200 g, roughly 260 kcal.
- Chicken and pepper stir-fry with sauce: about 150 g, roughly 250 kcal.
- Ice cream cone: about 90 g, roughly 200 kcal.

That comes to about 440 g and 710 kcal.

After eating, the plate is almost clean, with only a thin film of sauce left. The cone wrapper is open and contains small remnants, so the cone was essentially all eaten. I assumed about 95% of the food was consumed, which gives roughly 420 g and about 680 kcal. The water is excluded from the mass.

{"kcal": 680, "mass_g": 420}
